renameDocumentDescription: Versions and old links are retained. Keep the same file extension.
unableToRenameDocument: Could not rename. Check the name and extension, close open editors and refresh if the document changed. Existing files are never overwritten.
documentRenamePreservedOriginal: The document was renamed. The previous file was retained because its safe removal could not be verified.
availableAgentHelp: Only idle agents linked to neither a task nor a deliverable are listed. Their history, name and working folder are preserved.
availableAgentsError: Unable to load available agents. Close and reopen this dialog to retry.
noAvailableAgents: No available agents in this project.
deliverableFolderSelectionHelp: Choose a local workspace and an existing folder. This does not move files or change existing document links.
deliverableFolderSelectionFailed: Could not select this folder. Check that it exists in an available workspace and that you have access.
lifecycleDraftDefinition: The deliverable is being defined. Its content and validation criteria can still be prepared.
lifecycleConstitutionDefinition: The documents are being created or revised, by people or agents.
lifecycleValidationDefinition: The finalized deliverable requires approval of its document versions before it can be considered validated.
lifecycleFinalizedDefinition: The deliverable is complete. When validation is required, its document versions have been approved. Reopen it to resume work.
lifecycleArchivedDefinition: The deliverable is kept for reference. Unarchive it before resuming work.
